metadata.reviewer: Codex source-label/tag and personal residue review, not field survey
metadata.method: Scanned all3118 candidate names, then raw tags for642 noise/housing candidates. Deterministic class rules apply to every source; literal project-phase merges individually source-reviewed. Institutionalhousing qualification annotation consumed by Arabic/English display helper. No automatic renewal of approvals.

sampleReview.sampling: Random300 included identities frozen during round7, all personally read in3batches; final names/source eligibility rechecked after residue fixes. Frozen IDs all remain included. This is a desktop source/display audit, not field validation.
sampleReview.corrections: SmartVillage, InternationalPark, companycontractBuildings and bareordinal removed by general/exact reviewed rules. Restricted Arabic lexicon, institutional qualifiers and semantic Housing/City/Village descriptor retention corrected across catalog. Residue source-names such as OlympicVillage/UtilitiesCompound were retained as residential-tagged named estates with explicit uncertainty, not guessed to be facilities.
